days.title: First evening in Fukuoka
days.notes: Ease into the trip with a riverside walk and a bowl of Hakata ramen. Demo adapted from Lonely Planet Japan (19th ed., 2026). Dates, transfer choices, travel times and prices are illustrative; nothing is booked. Per-person inputs: €45/day living, €60/night room share, plus listed transport. Arrival and onward travel are excluded.

days.title: Fukuoka between meals
days.notes: Spend time around Ohori Park, then explore the shops and food stalls around the center. Stay in the same base tonight.

days.title: Across Kyushu to Nagasaki
days.notes: Take the train west, then explore the harbor and the streets around Dejima. Save the memorial sites for tomorrow.

blocks.notes: Rail via Takeo-Onsen, changing between the connecting limited express and the Nishi Kyushu Shinkansen.

days.title: Nagasaki: memory and the port
days.notes: Allow a quiet morning for the Atomic Bomb Museum and Peace Park. Use the afternoon for the city's port history and hillside streets.

days.title: Into the mountains to Kurokawa
days.notes: Use much of the day for the move to Kurokawa Onsen. Keep the evening for a gentle village walk and a bath.

blocks.notes: Return by rail to Hakata, then take the highway bus to Kurokawa. This long transfer needs coordinated connections; the estimate allows a change in Hakata.

days.title: From the onsen to Kumamoto
days.notes: Leave the mountain village by bus through the Aso region. Use the remaining afternoon around Kumamoto Castle and the city center.

blocks.notes: Kyushu Odan bus toward Kumamoto. The rounded estimate includes town access; it does not include a crater excursion.

days.title: South to Kagoshima
days.notes: Continue by shinkansen and spend the afternoon getting to know Kagoshima. Look across the bay toward Sakurajima.

blocks.notes: Kyushu Shinkansen to Kagoshima-Chuo, with local access at each end.

days.title: A day beside the volcano
days.notes: Enjoy the gardens and bay views around Kagoshima. Keep an easy afternoon for the waterfront and regional food.

days.title: Across the water to Yakushima
days.notes: Take a daytime jetfoil to Miyanoura. Settle into the island and leave the forest walking for tomorrow.

blocks.notes: Jetfoil from Kagoshima to Miyanoura; rounded time includes port access and boarding. Routing and crossing time vary by sailing.

days.title: Yakushima: a day for the forest
days.notes: Choose a forest walk suited to the weather and your energy, with a local bus or taxi connection from Miyanoura. The plan ends on Yakushima; the return crossing and onward travel are separate.
